notes.title: More Progress Underway for The Perdition Man
notes.content: [p][b]Major Update[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I have been working very consistently for the last few months with creating levels and items in Blender to be used in The Perdition Man. This is a lot of the heavy lifting that goes into game development, and large leaps in this department is only going to improve the quality for the end user. That being said over the last year, I have worked out many of the design choices and story that will be in this title. I will certainly be keeping everyone in the loop as more gets done. I am working very hard to give my audience something I personally will look back at and be proud of. Thank you all who have wish listed or checked out this project, [b]I am working hard for you![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44334474/4060ed94d6198a8e0d3d5887cac3572dcd53799e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44334474/59b1869b17135f5d8a4e08cdb238940580f2fe15.png"][/img][/p]
